name: Trillionaire Mercenaries of 21XX
storyline: On a post-climate-change, waterlogged Earth, three tech companies war over what remains, each racing to construct an artificial God; whoever finishes first owns the future. You play a lone mercenary hired by trillionaires who want to tip the global balance of power and resources. Your client, retired trillionaire Vector Hennigan, offers you $60,000 and a 1954 Fender Stratocaster to steal one laptop. As it turns out, it was never just one job.
summary: In 21XX, humanity clings to the remains of a cyberpunk world consumed by the ocean. As corporations fight for what's left, you work as a mercenary for the ultra-rich, carrying out covert operations in a third-person stealth adventure across an open-world ocean that tips the balance of global power.
